name: migrate-design-system
summary: Map this system to or from another one, and keep the crosswalk as a record rather than a one-off translation.

when: work has to interoperate with Material, HIG, Fluent, Carbon, shadcn, Radix or similar
a system is being adopted or replaced
not: moving call sites off a class this system already replaced

steps: Build the crosswalk at the SEMANTIC tier. Primitive-to-primitive mapping produces a palette that resolves and means nothing.
Name what has no counterpart. The gaps are the actual finding; the matches are the easy half.
Verify contrast after mapping — another system's token that resolves here may not pass here.
output: A crosswalk table plus an explicit list of what does not map.
done: every mapped pair passes contrast in this system
unmapped concepts are listed rather than quietly dropped
